latHint: Think a lone elephant that has wandered away from the herd.
pivHint: A RAKE gathers fallen leaves - but in old novels a RAKE is a charming, mischievous ______.
winText: Charming trouble. RAKE was the pivot - a leaf tool to a dashing ROGUE.
lossText: ROGUE - a charming scoundrel. RAKE was the pivot: a lawn RAKE to the dashing RAKE of old novels, a ROGUE.
